methods.description: Hex to bytes; tolerates a 0x prefix.

methods.summary: Computes a header's block id, also called the index block hash.
methods.description:
Computes a header's block id, also called the index block hash.

The id is sha512/256(block_hash || consensus_hash). A Nakamoto block hash is
its signer signature hash; a 2.x one hashes the whole header.

methods.summary: Narrows a Stacks header to an epoch 2.x header.
methods.description: Narrows a Stacks header to an epoch 2.x header.

methods.summary: Parses the epoch 2.x block header at the start of `raw`.
methods.description:
Parses the epoch 2.x block header at the start of `raw`.

`raw` is a header from `/v2/headers`, or block bytes from `/v2/blocks/<id>`.
`consensusHash` is the 20-byte hash of the sortition that elected the block.

methods.summary: Parse the NakamotoBlockHeader at the start of raw block bytes (`/v3/blocks/<id>`).
methods.description:
Parse the NakamotoBlockHeader at the start of raw block bytes
(`/v3/blocks/<id>`). Handles v0 and v1 (v1 appends `problematic_txs`).

methods.summary: Hashes a Nakamoto header the way its signers sign it.
methods.description:
Hashes a Nakamoto header the way its signers sign it.

It is sha512/256 over every header field except the signer signatures, which
is also the header's `block_hash`.

methods.summary: Hashes a key to its MARF path: sha512/256 of the UTF-8 key.
methods.description: Hashes a key to its MARF path: sha512/256 of the UTF-8 key.

methods.summary: Lists the ancestor tries a MARF proof crosses.
methods.description:
Lists the ancestor tries a MARF proof crosses.

Each id is the backptr a descendant trie follows toward the leaf, and
`verifyMarfProof` needs every one's header. They are read from untrusted
proof bytes, so they are only fetch hints: the proof still fails unless each
header hashes to the id the trie committed. Malformed proofs yield no ids.

methods.summary: Hashes a value to its MARF value: sha512/256, padded to 40 bytes.
methods.description: Hashes a value to its MARF value: sha512/256, padded to 40 bytes.

methods.summary: Verifies a MARF inclusion proof.
methods.description:
Verifies a MARF inclusion proof.

It is true only when `value` is stored at `path` in the MARF whose tip root
is `root`. Inclusion only: MARF proofs cannot prove absence. Malformed proof
bytes verify false.

methods.summary: Classify every leaf of block N's trie against the claimed write set.
methods.description:
Classify every leaf of block N's trie against the claimed write set.
Each leaf must be a claimed write, a carried (unchanged) parent value, or a
MARF-internal key; anything else is a hidden write.

methods.summary: Parse a v2 state witness and recompute its root.
methods.description:
Parse a v2 state witness and recompute its root. Throws on malformed input.
The result proves nothing until `root` equals a header's state_index_root.

methods.summary: Decodes a `cycle-signer-set` value from the `.signers` contract.
methods.description:
Decodes a `cycle-signer-set` value from the `.signers` contract.

The value is hex or bytes, as stored in the MARF:
`(some (list (tuple (signer principal) (weight uint) ...)))`.

methods.summary: Sums the weight of the signers who signed a block header.
methods.description:
Sums the weight of the signers who signed a block header.

It recovers each header signature's key over `signer_signature_hash`, maps it
to its mainnet p2pkh principal, and sums weights from `set`. The set must be
the one for the reward cycle of the tenure-electing burn block.

methods.summary: First burn height of reward cycle `cycle`.
methods.description: First burn height of reward cycle `cycle`.

methods.summary: Reward cycle containing `burnHeight`.
methods.description: Reward cycle containing `burnHeight`.

methods.summary: Check `preimage` against a 20-byte consensus hash.
methods.description:
Check `preimage` against a 20-byte consensus hash. Returns the burn block
hash as hex, already in Bitcoin display order (as `bitcoin-cli
getblockhash` prints it), or null when the preimage does not match.

methods.description: The MARF key of a data variable: `vm::<contract>::1::<var>`.

methods.description:

The holder is serde-JSON PrincipalData, e.g. `{"Standard":[22,[...20 bytes]]}`.

types.name: BlockDiff
types.summary: A block's witnessed leaves, split into writes, carried, and internal.

fields.name: writes
fields.description: Leaves matching a claimed write (path and value).

fields.name: carried
fields.description: Unclaimed leaves holding the parent's value: copied forward, not written.

fields.name: internal
fields.description: Leaves matching a `__MARF_*` bookkeeping entry.

fields.name: hidden
fields.description: Leaves nothing explains: an unreported write. Non-empty = reject.

fields.name: missing
fields.description: Claimed write keys with no leaf holding the claimed value. Non-empty = reject.

fields.name: complete
fields.description: No hidden leaves and no missing writes: the claimed writes are the block's complete diff.

types.name: BlockDiffInput
types.summary: The witness leaves, claimed writes, and bookkeeping keys to classify.

fields.name: leaves
fields.description: `parseWitness(bytes).leaves`, from a witness whose root was checked.

fields.name: writes
fields.description: Claimed writes of the block: [key, value string] as stored by Clarity.

fields.name: internal
fields.description: MARF bookkeeping keys (`__MARF_*`) with their raw 40-byte MARFValue hex, derived from the header chain.

fields.name: parentValue
fields.description: Value at `pathHex` in the PARENT block's state (40-byte MARFValue hex), already proven by the caller.

types.name: Bytes
types.summary: A byte string, held as a Uint8Array.

fields.name: path
fields.description: Full 32-byte trie path: `marfPath(key)`.

fields.name: valueHash
fields.description: 32-byte value hash (first 32 bytes of the MARFValue; the tail is zero).

fields.name: burnSpent
fields.description: total_work.burn: burn spent on the fork so far.

fields.name: chainLength
fields.description: total_work.work: the Stacks chain length (one per anchored block).

fields.name: stateIndexRoot
fields.description: Covers the block and the parent microblock stream it confirms.

fields.name: blockHash
fields.description: sha512/256 of the serialized header.

types.name: MarfProofInput
types.summary: A MARF proof with the leaf path and value it covers.

fields.name: proof
fields.description: Consensus-serialized TrieMerkleProof (`/v2/clarity/marf/<path>?proof=1`).

fields.name: path
fields.description: Leaf path: `marfPath(key)`.

fields.name: value
fields.description: 40-byte MARFValue: `marfValue(valueString)`.

fields.name: root
fields.description: Tip state_index_root, from a header the caller authenticated.

fields.name: headers
fields.description:
Tip header plus every ancestor header the proof crosses. Each contributes
state_index_root -> recomputed block id, so ancestor roots are only ever
vouched for by header bytes (a bare root->id map would let a forged
ancestor trie through).

fields.name: version
fields.description: Low 7 bits = header version; high bit = shadow block.

fields.name: signerSignatures
fields.description: 65-byte recoverable signatures: recovery id, r, s.

fields.name: signerSighashPreimage
fields.description: Header bytes minus the signer_signature vec: the signer sighash preimage.

fields.name: byteLength
fields.description: Serialized header length; block bytes after this are the transactions.

types.name: SignerCheck
types.summary: Whether the signed weight meets the threshold with known signers.

fields.name: valid
fields.description: Signed weight meets the threshold, and every signature is a distinct known signer.

fields.name: threshold
fields.description: ceil(total * 7 / 10).

fields.name: signers
fields.description: Recovered signer principals that counted, in signature order.

fields.name: unknown
fields.description: Recovered principals not in the set.

fields.name: duplicates
fields.description: Principals that signed more than once.

fields.name: invalid
fields.description: Signatures that do not recover (malformed or high-S).

fields.name: forEach
fields.type: (callbackfn: (value: bigint, key: string, map: Map<string, bigint>) => void, thisArg?: any) => void
fields.description: Executes a provided function once per each key/value pair in the Map, in insertion order.

fields.name: get
fields.description: Returns a specified element from the Map object. If the value that is associated to the provided key is an object, then you will get a reference to that object and any change made to that object will effectively modify it inside the Map.

fields.name: set
fields.description: Adds a new element with a specified key and value to the Map. If an element with the same key already exists, the element will be updated.

fields.name: entries
fields.description: Returns an iterable of key, value pairs for every entry in the map.

fields.name: keys
fields.description: Returns an iterable of keys in the map

fields.name: values
fields.description: Returns an iterable of values in the map

types.name: StacksHeader
types.summary: A Stacks block header from either era.

types.name: StateWitness
types.summary: A recomputed trie root, its ancestor roots, and leaves.

fields.name: root
fields.description: Recomputed trie root; compare to the authenticated header's state_index_root.

fields.name: ancestorRoots
fields.description: Skip-list ancestor trie roots folded into `root`.

fields.name: path
fields.description: Full 32-byte trie path: `marfPath(key)`.

fields.name: valueHash
fields.description: 32-byte value hash (first 32 bytes of the MARFValue; the tail is zero).
